import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(column, data):
    if not data:
        raise ValueError("data list is empty")

    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

    if column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(column)

    for required in ("steps", "calories burned", "distance walked"):
        if required not in df.columns:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing required column: {required}")
        numeric_series = pd.to_numeric(df[required], errors="raise")
        if (numeric_series < 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{required} contains negative values")

    values = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors="raise")

    def _scalar(v):
        return v.item() if hasattr(v, "item") else v

    stats = {
        "sum": _scalar(values.sum()),
        "mean": _scalar(values.mean()),
        "min": _scalar(values.min()),
        "max": _scalar(values.max()),
    }

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(df["Date"], values)
    ax.set_xlabel("Date")
    ax.set_ylabel(column)
    ax.set_title(f"Line Chart of {column}")

    return stats, ax
